events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Deion Jones made a leaping interception in the end zone with 1:25 remaining and the Atlanta Falcons held on for a crucial 20-17 victory over the New Orleans Saints on Thursday night, setting up a three-way race for the NFC South title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones makes game-saving catch, Falcons beats Saints 20-17

headlines.description: LeSean McCoy scored on a 21-yard run with 1:33 left in overtime to secure the Buffalo Bills' 13-7 win over the Indianapolis Colts in a wintry, white-out setting best suited for snow shoes and sled dogs.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCoy scores to seal Bills' 13-7 OT win over Colts

headlines.description: Rookie Mitchell Trubisky threw for a touchdown and ran for another in his best showing yet, and the Chicago Bears ended a five-game losing streak by routing the lackluster Cincinnati Bengals 33-7 on Sunday, their most lopsided victory in five years.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trubisky, Howard lead Bears over hapless Bengals 33-7

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: The Green Bay Packers came back to set the stage for Aaron Rodgers' comeback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers rally to stun winless Browns 27-21 in overtime

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Kareem Hunt ran for 116 yards and a touchdown, the Chiefs shut down Derek Carr and Raiders offense and Kansas City held on to beat Oakland 26-15 on Sunday to snap a four-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Hunt, defense spur Chiefs to 26-15 victory over Raiders

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New York Giants

headlines.description: Dak Prescott threw three touchdown passes and the desperate Dallas Cowboys beat New York 30-10 Sunday to spoil Steve Spagnuolo's debut as interim coach and the return of quarterback Eli Manning to the Giants' starting lineup.
headlines.shortLinkText: Prescott throws 3 TDs as Cowboys spoil Eli's return

events.name: Detroit Lions at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford passed for 381 yards with an injured throwing hand and set up Matt Prater for a 46-yard field goal in the closing seconds Sunday, helping the Detroit Lions remain in playoff contention with a 24-21 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford's 4th winning drive leads Lions over Bucs 24-21

headlines.description: Jonathan Stewart ran for 103 yards and three touchdowns, and the Carolina Panthers snapped the Minnesota Vikings' eight-game winning streak with a 31-24 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stewart runs for 3 TDs, Panthers beat Vikings 31-24

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo threw for a career-high 334 yards and a touchdown to help the San Francisco 49ers to their second straight win, 26-16, over the Houston Texans on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Garoppolo leads 49ers to 26-16 win over Texans

events.name: New York Jets at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: The Broncos snapped their longest losing streak since joining the NFL in 1970 with a 23-0 shutout of the New York Jets on Sunday thanks to wide receiver Demaryius Thomas' big game and a return of Denver's stingy defense.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos end 8-game skid with 23-0 win over Jets

headlines.description: Phil Dawson kicked four second-half field goals and the Arizona Cardinals shut down Tennessee's offense nearly all day Sunday in a 12-7 victory over the Titans, who had entered the game leading the AFC South.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cardinals beat Titans on Dawson's 4 field goals

events.name: Washington Redskins at Los Angeles Chargers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers passed for 319 yards and two touchdowns, and the Los Angeles Chargers continued their ferocious playoff push with their fourth straight victory, 30-13 over the Washington Redskins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rivers leads Bolts to 4th straight win, 30-13 over Redskins

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Carson Wentz threw for 291 yards and four touchdowns before leaving with a knee injury and Jake Elliott kicked the go-ahead 33-yard field goal with 3:45 left for the Philadelphia Eagles, who beat the Los Angeles Rams 43-35 in a thriller Sunday to...
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles lose Wentz to injury, beat Rams 43-35 to win NFC East

headlines.description: Blake Bortles threw two perfect passes for touchdowns, Jaydon Mickens set up another score with a 72-yard punt return and the Jacksonville Jaguars beat the Seattle Seahawks 30-24 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars beat Seahawks 30-24, take outright lead in AFC South

headlines.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers won one for injured star Ryan Shazier -- and wrapped up the AFC North in the process.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers lock up AFC North with 39-38 win over Ravens

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Tom Brady was intercepted twice by Xavien Howard and held without a third-down conversion Monday night, and the Miami Dolphins snapped the New England Patriots' eight-game winning streak with a surprising 27-20 victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady intercepted twice as Dolphins beat Pats 27-20
